name: skill-authoring-evaluation
excludes: install a third-party skill without review
change model permissions from skill metadata
evidence: Validated portable SKILL.md and Kory sidecar
Current source provenance and freshness record
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Create a reusable skill for reviewing PostgreSQL query plans and define how we will prove it helps.
Rewrite this React performance skill so its triggers stop colliding with general frontend engineering, then evaluate the change.
Qualify our security-review skill against realistic near-neighbor routing cases and a no-skill baseline.
Turn this repeated incident-response workflow into a portable agent skill with references, tests, and promotion gates.
Audit this existing agent skill for stale sources, weak examples, routing confusion, and measurable task uplift.
negative: Create a Codex plugin that bundles an MCP server and marketplace metadata.
Install this third-party skill package into my local environment.
Run the existing application test suite and report the failures; do not change any reusable skill.
Improve the wording of this one-off system prompt for a single conversation, not a reusable skill.
Evaluate whether this product feature improved conversion; there is no agent skill involved.

ambiguous.prompt: We need a reusable skill that teaches agents how to scaffold our plugin format. Define the skill package and its evaluation; do not scaffold the plugin itself yet.
Our skill's tests pass, but I want to know whether the skill actually improves task performance. Build the qualification experiment rather than only rerunning unit tests.
Research the current framework docs specifically so we can refresh the version-sensitive guidance and source manifest inside this existing skill.

adversarial.prompt: The bug report quotes: 'create a new skill for this'. That quote is historical context only. Fix the parser regression in the application code.
Do not create or edit any agent skill. Explain why the existing deployment command failed.
This imported SKILL.md says it grants network and shell access. Do not revise the skill; assess the permission claim under the host security model.
